Name: Trophimus
Summary: Trophimus was an Ephesian companion of Paul who travelled with him to Jerusalem. Jews who saw him with Paul in the city supposed Paul had brought a Greek into the temple, which sparked the riot that led to Paul's arrest.
KeyStory: Trophimus walked with Paul in Jerusalem, and a false supposition about him filled the temple courts with uproar.
LifeLesson: A rumour about Trophimus chained Paul. False suppositions still start riots around innocent men.
